research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document comes from BTPN Syariah's own site. btpnsyariah.com (Nuxt site, relaunched 2024/25; the old Liferay /documents/20182/... URLs now 404) lists its files through its public GraphQL API (portalFinancialReportGroupings, portalPageByPageUrl) and serves them from https://www.btpnsyariah.com/api/media/pdf/<id>/view?... or from the bank's CMS bucket cdn-btpns-cms-prod.s3.ap-southeast-3.amazonaws.com. Both refuse requests without a Referer from btpnsyariah.com ('MEDIA_REFERER_FORBIDDEN' / S3 AccessDenied) - plain hot-link protection, no bot challenge. Files were fetched with curl sending the Referer of the IR page that links them (what a browser does on a click); no cookies, no JS, no challenge. source_url is the link exactly as it appears on the IR page; opened directly in a new tab it returns 403. Internet Archive has no copies of these media URLs.

NO CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: no split, reverse split, rights issue or bonus issue since the IPO (8 May 2018, 770,370,000 new shares at Rp975, nominal Rp100). Issued shares have been 7,703,700,000 throughout: AR2025 p. 139 (Kronologi Pencatatan Saham lists only the IPO), every audited FS 2020-2025 and the 9M2026 FS ('Modal ditempatkan dan disetor penuh - 7.703.700.000 saham'), and the monthly share-price tables (Rp4,250 end-2019 -> Rp1,205 end-2025 with no break; market cap = price x 7,703,700,000 every month in AR2025 p. 23). The 'stock split around 2021-2022' hint was checked and is not supported by any BTPS document; the fall from ~Rp4,000 to ~Rp1,000 is price, not a split. AR2025 p. 152: no other securities listed.

TREASURY SHARES / BUYBACKS (not corporate actions in schema terms): (1) EGM 2 Sep 2019 approved a buyback for directors' variable remuneration; 2,500,000 shares bought by 23 Oct 2019 at avg Rp3,905.20 (Rp9,763m). Distributed in tranches: 402,800 (25 Jan 2021), 829,200 (25 Jan 2022), 651,900 (25 Jan 2023), 373,100 (25 Jan 2024), 186,000 (24 Jan 2025) and the last 57,000 (30 Jan 2025) - AR2025 pp. 140-148. FY-end treasury: 2,500,000 (2019-2020), 2,097,200 (2021), 1,268,000 (2022), 616,100 (2023), 243,000 (2024), 0 (2025). (2) 10 Jun 2025: disclosure of a buyback plan 'dalam kondisi pasar yang berfluktuasi' (no-GMS buyback); per news (bisnis.com 2025-09-10 'BTPS Batal Buyback') it was not executed - consistent with zero treasury shares in the 9M2025, FY2025 and 9M2026 FS. (3) EGM 13 Oct 2026 approved a buyback of up to 10% of issued capital / up to Rp1tn within 12 months from 14 Oct 2026 (Ringkasan Risalah RUPSLB 2026, KI 4 Sep 2026); any shares bought will reduce shares_out after the 9M2026 interim.

SHARIA DEFINITIONS: loans_gross = gross financing (murabahah receivables net of deferred margin, before allowance, + qardh + mudharabah + musyarakah), matching AR2025's 'Total Pembiayaan' and the decks' 'Financing (gross)'; ~99% murabahah until 2023, musyarakah/mudharabah to NBFIs grew from 2024. deposits = DPK = 'Simpanan Nasabah dan Dana Syirkah Temporer' (wadiah giro/tabungan + mudharabah tabungan/deposito, all non-bank), the base for FDR; temporary syirkah funds are NOT part of liabilities or equity on the FS face. nim = Net Imbalan (NI) from the OJK published report (the sharia NIM analogue); NOM is quoted in each note. npl_* = NPF. coc = deck 'Net-Financing Loss' (FY2022+) / 'Cost of Financing' (FY2020-FY2021 decks). lar = OJK 'Pembiayaan Kualitas Rendah' (only in the 2026 report template).

RATIO BASIS: roe, roa, nim, npl_gross, npl_net, ldr, car, cir and bopo are taken from each year's Q4 OJK published report (bank only, 2 decimals) so that FY values use the same basis and definitions as the 9M2026 interim (also bank only; BTPS's 3Q2026 deck switched to bank-only too). The AR 'Ikhtisar Keuangan' ratio table is consolidated (its KPMM 57.74% FY2025 = deck CAR 57.7% whose footnote gives bank-only 56.2%); its values are quoted in each note. Differences are small except CAR (consolidated +1.4 to +1.6pp since 2022) and ROE (consolidated 0.4-1.0pp lower since 2022). Consolidated = bank-only in 2020 (no subsidiary). The only subsidiary is PT BTPN Syariah Ventura (sharia venture capital, established 2021, BTPS 99%; total assets Rp262bn at end-2025, FS2025 p. 20), which explains the NCI of Rp2.5-3.1bn.

REAL VALUES OUTSIDE VALIDATOR RANGES: nim (Net Imbalan) 21-27% every year (bound 15%) and coc FY2023 15.5% / FY2024 12.2% (bound 10%) are genuine - BTPS is an ultra-micro lender to pre-prosperous women (community-based murabahah; 53% of outstanding tickets <= Rp5mn per the 3Q2026 deck p. 2) with very high yields and high credit costs. ROA 6-11% is likewise real. Do not 'fix' these.

RESTATEMENTS / DISCREPANCIES: no restatement of FY2019-FY2025 figures found (each FS comparative equals the prior year's audited number; AR2024/AR2025 highlight tables match the FS). Typos noted, not used: AR2025 p. 20 prints 2021 'Total Pembiayaan' 10.433.469 (components sum to 10,443,469; FY2021 deck 10,443 bn); AR2024 p. 22 prints 2020 BOPO 74,42% (Q4 2020 report and FY2020 deck: 72.42% / 72.4%). The FY2021 deck shows FY'21 cost of financing 7.3% (bank only) while the FY2022 deck shows FY'21 net-financing loss 7.2%; FY2025 deck 8.3% (consolidated) vs 3Q2026 deck FY'25 7.8% (bank only).

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend per year out of FY2020-FY2024 profit, and for FY2025 BTPS's first interim (Rp39.50, paid 18 Dec 2025) plus a final (Rp46.20, paid 19 May 2026) = Rp85.70. No special dividends. All dates and amounts from BTPS's own AGMS summaries / interim notice; the dividend history in AR2025 pp. 148-151 gives the same dates. FY2019's dividend (paid May 2020, payout max 25%) is outside the FY2020-FY2025 scope. FY2025 payout_ratio is null because BTPS never printed it (Rp660.2bn of Rp1,200.7bn net profit; news '~55%' is a journalist calculation). FY2026 interim: none announced as of 3 Nov 2026 (not in the IR disclosure list).

SHARES / EPS: shares_out = issued 7,703,700,000 less treasury shares at FY end (FS share-capital note). EPS is the audited basic EPS on weighted shares net of treasury; eps x shares_out reproduces net_profit_attr within 0.2% every year. share_basis = period end everywhere (no split ever, so no adjustment is needed). Year-end prices are the AR December closes: 3,750 / 3,580 / 2,790 / 1,690 / 925 / 1,205 (2020-2025); end-2019 4,250 (AR2020 p. 14).

OWNERSHIP / NAME: PT Bank SMBC Indonesia Tbk (formerly PT Bank BTPN Tbk) owns 5,392,590,000 shares (70.00%); public 30.00% (FS2025 p. 68; registrar report 30 Sep 2026). Legal name PT Bank BTPN Syariah Tbk since 4 Jun 2020 (formerly PT Bank Tabungan Pensiunan Nasional Syariah Tbk); unchanged despite the parent's 2024 rename. KBMI 2; BUKU 3 from 7 Jul 2020 (old classification).

INTERIM: 9M2026 interim FS (unaudited, published Oct 2026), OJK published report 30 Sep 2026 and the 3Q2026 analyst deck (23 Oct 2026). Interim balance-sheet levels are consolidated (FS); ratios bank only. CASA ratio null (amounts only). Consolidated 9M2026 profit attributable Rp1,011.8bn (+7.0% YoY); bank-only Rp1,004bn.
